title: AC1024 physical entity, LAYER and LAYOUT extension-dictionary output closure

sourceTypeEvidence.observation: DWG object-map handles 28B and 290 were parsed with object type 34; src/intern/dwgutil.h maps dwgType::VIEWPORT to 34. Their source xDict control handles are 28C and 291.

operation.mode: Explicit partial DWG read; strict-complete conversion refused the source because its DWG read disposition is incomplete.

outputReadback.method: dx_iface::fileImport through /private/tmp/dictionary_profile, followed by direct emitted ASCII group inspection

readbackProbe.result: source_root=1 source_dictionary_callbacks=23 source_total=24; output_root=1 output_dictionary_callbacks=21 output_total=22; identity_matches=22 exact_records=20.

remainingProfile.requiredResearch: Prove the exact DXF TABLE-header/control-object handle and extension-dictionary encoding before output; do not substitute NOD ownership.

validation.addressSanitizer: PASS: owner graphs, graph limits and dictionary effective ownership
validation.build: PASS: build-gcc targets dwg2dxf and libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests with -Werror

failureBehavior.wrongDictionaryOwner: Refuses without replacing a sentinel destination; corrected owner retries successfully on the same adapter in ASCII and binary DXF.
failureBehavior.lateEntityExtensionOwnerMutation: Refuses publication without replacing the destination; restored owner retries successfully.
failureBehavior.sourceCompatibility: The XRECORD owned-extension matrix passes its version, ASCII/binary, readback, rollback and retry cases.

limitations: The explicit-partial physical conversion does not qualify complete DWG conversion or promote any support claim.
Strict-complete admission remains blocked by the physical source's 228 opaque callbacks and zero retained correlation frames.
The Layer Table Control owner route for handles 2A2/2A3 remains unresolved and unimplemented.
The 20 whole-record matches plus two verified VIEWPORT owner-handle remaps close only the audited dictionary identities; remaining callback profiles stay open.
next: Research and prove the Layer Table Control to DXF TABLE-header extension-dictionary mapping for 2A2/2A3; then continue with the highest-incidence unclosed physical callback profile.
